summary: Well‑executed, fully preregistered paired study with complete artifact archive; outcome is a reproducible ceiling/null result (200/200 valid applies in both arms). Execution, logging, and analysis appear internally consistent and verifiable from provided artifacts. The manuscript is scientifically honest about limitations and reproducibility but needs a few targeted clarifications and additional artifact‑grounded reporting to make interpretation and external reuse unambiguous.
required_revisions: Add an explicit aggregated summary (counts and percentages) of task difficulty levels (e.g., medium/hard/very_hard) and validator coverage indicators across the K=200 tasks, derived from the archived execution/scoring/*.json artifacts, and place that summary in Results (or a compact table). This will support the manuscript’s claim that the sampled pool produced a ceiling regime.

Clarify in the Abstract and in the Conclusion (single sentence each) that the preregistered confirmatory hypothesis H1 was not supported (no detectable marginal effect) and that the observed outcome is a ceiling‑case null — i.e., the study provides no evidence that verifier+repair improves outcomes under the tested task/model/validator regime and therefore is inconclusive about verifier value in failure‑rich or production distributions.

Add a one‑paragraph clarification in Methods/Analysis explaining why the paired bootstrap CI is degenerate ([0.00,0.00]) and why an exact McNemar test yields p=1.00 when no discordant pairs are observed; explicitly state the statistical consequence that the preregistered power calculation (targeting a baseline failure rate ≈ 0.20) was rendered inapplicable by the observed baseline=0 failure rate.

Explicitly report (in Methods or Disclosure) that the shared_initial_generation design fixes the generator output for both arms and therefore prevented any generator adaptation or repair‑triggered regeneration; add a single sentence connecting this design choice to the observed absence of repair invocations (repair_applied=false for all guarded episodes).
optional_revisions: Consider adding a compact table or short appendix (one figure) that lists the top 10 representative task IDs with their difficulty metadata, parsed_command_count, and validator.violation_count to aid rapid external auditing (artifacts exist under execution/scoring/ and representative_tasks).

Discuss briefly (one short paragraph) how an alternative paired estimand or an interactive generator–verifier estimand would change the experimental contract and inference target; cite the existing preregistered artifacts to show how the current design isolates verifier marginality.

If space permits, add an explicit pointer (file path + SHA‑256) in the manuscript to the analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv and analysis/condition_summary.csv so readers can locate the exact CSV artifacts referenced in Tables/Figures.
